groups.simulate_behavior: Device, allocation, copy, stream, event, and registration state is modeled on the host. Exact APIs can override this group classification.
Driver identity, context, allocation, copy, stream, event, module, and graph surfaces are modeled or forwarded according to runtime mode.
Maintained GEMM and matmul paths can execute on CPU; other algorithms and attributes may provide compatibility state only.
Identity and memory state are modeled. Hardware telemetry that cannot be observed is synthetic or explicitly unsupported.
Maintained collective and point-to-point calls use FakeGPU coordinator transports and analytical topology accounting.

Supported CPU paths execute numerically; synthetic output, unsupported data types, disabled CPU execution, and skipped GEMM computation obey the unsupported-API policy.

Supported CPU paths execute numerically; unsupported layouts, data types, pointer modes, epilogues, disabled CPU execution, and skipped computation obey the unsupported-API policy. CPU epilogues support DEFAULT, RELU, BIAS, RELU_BIAS, GELU, and GELU_BIAS; other values skip computation without writing output. Non-identity C transforms are always rejected without writing output, matching the cuBLASLt TRANSC restriction.
